name: Leonardo DiCaprio Wolf of Wall Street
look: Two stacked stills of Leonardo DiCaprio as Jordan Belfort on a yacht deck, in dark sunglasses and a white polo shirt. Top: he grins and clenches both fists excitedly while talking to a man in a dark suit. Bottom: he leans in, laughing hard with his mouth wide open.
use: A two-step reaction of glee. The top caption is something that gets Leo excited, and the bottom is the punchline or follow-up that makes him crack up, often at someone else's expense.
slots: the punchline that makes him laugh (bottom panel)
examples: My friend: I finally bought a sports car
Me when he pulls up in a minivan
Coworker: I'm starting my diet tomorrow
Me, who has heard that every day since January
